Recognition support--

The built-in preview supports selected static letters and simple J/Z motion. It is a geometric heuristic, not validated FSL accuracy.

Gather approved sign samples

Choose an approved sign, connect the camera, and capture varied samples. Data stays in this browser.

The built-in preview supports simple J/Z motion. For other dynamic signs, select Dynamic, capture at least 3 varied examples per sign while moving through its full path, then use Trained KNN. Re-capture dynamic samples saved before this update.
